items.reason: 'Patients with histone H3 K27M mutation or gliosarcoma' is an exclusion, so H3K27M absence is an entry requirement (manual §5). It is not linked to MBM-02/tempol. Coder B's omission is not supported by the literal rule.

By the literal rule, any eligibility biomarker other than IDH-wildtype used to define GBM counts, so the H3K27M-absence requirement makes any_molecular_selection true. The exclusion, like 'Diagnosis of midline diffuse glioma (glioblastoma)', is diagnostic (CNS5 entity), which argues for treating it like IDH-wildtype (false).
Four EXPERIMENTAL dose cohorts (1000/1200/1400 mg/day MBM-02), none a control. Manual: 'no' = more than one arm but none works as a control; 'not_applicable' is for single-arm trials.

note: Decision needed: should an H3K27M-absence exclusion that only defines GBM (excluding diffuse midline glioma) be exempt from any_molecular_selection like IDH-wildtype? If yes, any_molecular_selection = false.
